items.title: What Does McDonald's (MCD) New US President Mean For Its Next Phase?
items.summary: McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) has appointed Skye Anderson as President, McDonald's USA, as part of a planned leadership transition in its largest market. The company signals an emphasis on continuity in the U.S. business, with Anderson bringing experience across multiple segments of McDonald's global operations.
